text:
sanjay: Pushing canary v6-tokenizer to 10% now. Noticed p95 jump on a few hosts during warmup.
elaine: saw that on dashboards too — which hosts? any noisy-neighbor callouts?
perfbot: [alert] p95 latency increase detected on shard-gpu-7 (baseline 42ms -> 138ms) 
toni: stacktrace/profiler? do we have perf traces for that host?
kai: attaching flamegraph link: http://perf.internal/fg/2471112222
sanjay: short summary: kernel-decider flipped to slow matmul path on some RPCs, kv-cache hit rate dropped from 86% -> 40% for v6
claire: how did the kv-cache get thrashed? was it eviction due to batching skew?
sanjay: looks like tokenizer change -> more subword fragments per prompt -> longer generated sequences -> eviction pressure. also we hit a new batcher heuristic that groups by token count which caused cross-tenant mixing
elaine: interesting — so both kernel selection and kv cache are affected by seq-len distribution shift
toni: profiler snippet:
```
CPU  45%  runtime::kernel_selector
GPU  62%  matmul_slow_path
KVCacheManager: evict_count +213%
Batcher: avg_batchesize -18%
```
kai: also noticed kernel-decider uses avg_seq_len per-model computed from historical tokenization. our canary had a tokenization change but we didn't reset the histograms
claire: deploy-bot shows canary traffic included some high-req-volume tenants, maybe noisy neighbor amplified
deploy-bot: canary rollout: v6-tokenizer -> 12% traffic at 12:04 UTC; rollback not triggered
sanjay: quick mitigation: pause canary, pin canary hosts to no-mix routing (noisy-tenant isolation), bump KV cache soft limit +20% on shard-gpu-7
toni: applied kv soft limit bump on shard-gpu-7, moving to monitor
elaine: added a one-off histogram refresh job to recompute model seq_len distribution from last 24h for v6
kai: proposal: make kernel-decider fallback to stable kernel for first 5000 requests after a model tokenizer change or model-metadata update
claire: +1 — and add canary traffic partitioning by tenant to avoid mixing hot tenants with new models
sanjay: logs after mitigations: kv-hit 62% on shard-gpu-7, p95 back to ~48ms
perfbot: [resolved] p95 alert cleared for shard-gpu-7
toni: next steps: CI hook to invalidate seq_len histograms on model metadata changes; small PR to kernel-decider toggles; follow-up postmortem
elaine: I'll own the postmortem, collecting traces and a /runbook addendum for canary isolation
claire: thanks team, good catch. rolling out rollback policy to staging too :thumbsup:
